sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire easy-sticky-sidebar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or search for “WordPress CTA Plugin” on WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will find ‘WP CTA’ menu in your WordPress admin panel.
  4. Once you are on the WP CTA admin panel, you can edit and change the image, text, fonts, colors and url of the CTA then click save.
  5. Choose development mode first so you can test and edit your CTA first. Development mode will only show to admins who are logged in. Live will show to everyone.
  6. Go to your home page and refresh. Once the page reloads, you will CTA on the right hand side.
  7. When you scroll down the CTA will collapse so that it does not take up too much room.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin helps get the interest of your website users and directs them to a link of your choice. This is a great way to increase sales and generate leads.

Is there a pro version?

Yes, you can purchase the pro version here https://wpctapro.com/pricing/

Does it require a person to know coding?

No. WP CTA is very easy to use, just replace the text, image and url and you are all set. Our Pro Version
has a HTML/Shortcode template where you can add you own custom code if you wish to do so.

Will the plugin slow down my site?

No. WP CTA is very light weight, it will not affect your loading time at all.

Is there documentation?

Please visit this page for more instructions: WP CTA Plugin Help

Is there demos?

Please visit our demos page here: Demos
